**Summary:**

I investigated ticket T-2007 and found that the `inventory-db-0` PostgreSQL pod is crashing with checkpoint corruption errors following an unexpected node reboot. The logs show "invalid primary checkpoint record" and "invalid resource manager ID in checkpoint record" errors - symptoms of data corruption from an unclean shutdown. This requires specialized PostgreSQL recovery tools and DBA expertise to resolve safely without risking data loss, so I escalated the ticket to a human engineer for proper intervention.
